title: Spring Data JPA
description: Review entities, repositories, relationships, transactions, and derived queries.

questions.questionText: Which annotation marks a class as a JPA entity?
questions.solution: @Entity tells the JPA provider that the class is mapped to persistent data.

questions.questionText: Which repository interface provides basic CRUD operations?
questions.solution: CrudRepository defines common save, find, count, and delete operations.

questions.questionText: What does mappedBy identify on the inverse side of a relationship?
questions.solution: mappedBy refers to the field that owns and stores the relationship mapping.

questions.questionText: Which annotation defines a transactional boundary?
questions.solution: @Transactional instructs Spring to execute the method within a managed transaction.

questions.questionText: What can findByEmailAndActive express in a Spring Data repository?
questions.optionA: A derived query based on method-name properties
questions.solution: Spring Data can derive a query from supported property names and operators in a repository method.
